question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given phrase.

Feel the pinch
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Experience hardship**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Feel the pinch"** refers to experiencing financial difficulty or hardship. (कठिनाई महसूस करना)

 
 
• **Example:** After losing his job, he really started to feel the pinch when it came to paying the bills.
 
 
 
• **"Experience hardship"** means undergoing difficult or challenging times, often related to money or resources. (कठिनाई का अनुभव करना)
 
 
• **Example:** Many families experience hardship during an economic crisis.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Experience hardship**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Give pain** (दर्द देना): To cause physical or emotional suffering.

 
 
• **Example:** The sharp edge of the chair gave him pain when he sat down carelessly.
 
 
 
• **Raise quality** (गुणवत्ता बढ़ाना): To improve or enhance the standard of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The company is working hard to raise the quality of its products.
 
 
 
• **Demand something** (कुछ मांगना): To ask for something firmly or with authority.
 
 
• **Example:** The workers demanded a pay raise after years of stagnant wages.
